cases.description: Each person's meeting list holds only the meetings they may read.
procedure: As Member D (in no [SYS] meeting) open "Cuộc họp" with all statuses and search "[SYS]".
As Member C search "[SYS] WF-10": one Draft and one Published meeting exist where Member C is a plain member.
As the Organizer search the same.
expected: Member D's list and the API return no [SYS] meeting.
Member C sees the Published meeting but not the Draft one.
preconditions: WF-02 to WF-08 were run; a Draft and a Published "[SYS] WF-10" meeting with Member C as member.
cases.aiNote: BF-01 · UC-16 · BR-016, BR-017 · 5.2: MEET_FT36 · Evidence: QA run SYS-WF10 20261123-065540-0c98bde8 · Run by the QA runner on a local build of app 6baba24f.

cases.description: A direct URL to a meeting the person may not read answers exactly like an unknown URL, for an outsider, a member of a Draft, the Administrator and an unassigned approver.
procedure: As Member D open the URL of the Published WF-10 meeting.
Call GET /api/meetings/{id} as Member D (and with an unknown id), as Member C on the Draft, as the Administrator and as the second Approver on the Published one.
As the Administrator open the same URL.
expected: The page is "Không tìm thấy trang" for Member D and the Administrator.
Every call answers 404, and Member D's answer is identical to the one for an unknown id (existence not revealed).

cases.description: Minutes, votes, documents, recordings and agenda of meetings the person is not part of are not reachable.
procedure: As Member D call the minutes, votes, documents, recordings and agenda of the WF-03 meeting, and the content of the Mật meeting document of WF-08.
Open the minutes tab and the document viewer URLs in the browser.
Call the minutes without signing in.
expected: Every call answers 404; both pages show "Không tìm thấy trang".
Without a session the API answers 401.

cases.description: A verified guest sees the meeting they were invited to and nothing else.
procedure: As the guest of WF-05, verified by the emailed code, open the invited meeting, then try another meeting's URL and the personal library.
expected: The guest reads only the invited meeting and its documents; other URLs are not found; there is no personal library.
preconditions: A guest session (code read from a real mailbox).
